# The Symphony of Chance and Certainty

**A Comprehensive Reference in Statistics & Probability — from Mathematical Roots to the Frontiers of AI**

An encyclopaedic reference in eight parts and thirty-eight lessons: exploratory data analysis, foundations of probability, distributions, statistical inference, regression, Bayesian statistics, Markov chains and Monte Carlo simulation, and statistics at the heart of AI, plus eight reference appendices.

![The Symphony of Chance and Certainty](books/probability-statistics-for-ai/cover.png)

## What you will learn

- **The Art of Exploring Data — Descriptive Statistics** — 4 chapters & appendices
- **Taming Chance — Foundations of Probability** — 4 chapters & appendices
- **Shapes of Uncertainty — Random Variables & Distributions** — 5 chapters & appendices
- **From the Drop to the Ocean — Inferential Statistics** — 4 chapters & appendices
- **Discovering Relations — Correlation & Regression** — 3 chapters & appendices
- **Bayesian Statistics — Updating Beliefs with Evidence** — 2 chapters & appendices
- **Stochastic Processes & Simulation** — 2 chapters & appendices
